description: This Java class 'DOMHelper' provides utility methods for processing XML DOM Nodes, such as extracting text content and parsing attribute values into different data types.

classes.name: DOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to extract and convert XML node data, including text extraction and attribute parsing with default values.

methods.name: unmarshallText
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text from a DOM Node, aggregating all child text nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (String, String, String)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute as a String, returns default if attribute not found.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (Node, String, double)
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value as a Double, parsing from String, with default fallback.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (Node, String, int)
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value as an Integer, parsing from String, with default fallback.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (Node, String, boolean)
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value as a Boolean, parsing from String, with default fallback.
